args.message: Brooklyn's longest run of month-over-month growth in pre-tax sales (net_sales) was 6 months, from October 2023 through March 2024. Sales rose every month in that stretch, from 47,249 in September 2023 to 106,350 in March 2024, then fell in April 2024 (net_sales is labelled "Net Sales (cents)" in the data, though the measure's description says dollars). The next-longest runs were 4 months each: October 2024 to January 2025, and October 2025 to January 2026. I compared each month with the month before. Whether or not June 2023 is compared with May changes nothing, because that early run (June to August 2023) is only 3 months long.

Sales rose every month in that stretch, from 47,249 in September 2023 to 106,350 in March 2024, then fell in April 2024 (net_sales is labelled "Net Sales (cents)" in the data, though the measure's description says dollars). The next-longest runs were 4 months each: October 2024 to January 2025, and October 2025 to January 2026. I compared each month with the month before. Whether or not June 2023 is compared with May changes nothing, because that early run (June to August 2023) is only 3 months long.
